verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents eval runs, experiments, or a side-by-side comparison of evaluation results across prompt or model versions. The prompt-management claim to 'compare versions, and rollback' (helicone-docs-18) is about prompt version history, an adjacent feature. Webhook-driven 'real-time evaluation' (helicone-docs-23) only supplies scores to an external system, which is a developer building block. Neither delivers comparison of eval runs to catch regressions.
